items.title: Retail investors are buying Nvidia's stock crash like never before — history urges patience
items.summary: Dip buyers set a record in Nvidia on Thursday as the chart flashed a possible bottom.

items.title: Alleged spy at center of Nvidia CEO affair reportedly being probed over Super Micro smuggling effort
items.summary: The woman at the center of the Nvidia affair scandal is also reportedly being probed for involvement in a separate chip smuggling scheme.

items.title: Cathie Wood: After Huang, AI push isn’t ‘going to stop’
items.summary: ARK Invest CEO and CIO Cathie Wood joins Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss why the AI industry will outlast any one leader, amid the  Jensen Huang crisis at Nvidia (NVDA).

items.title: CoreWeave stock sinks as resignation of Jensen Huang ripples through AI trade
items.summary: CoreWeave stock sank on Thursday as the impact of leadership change at Nvidia weighed on the AI trade and companies backed by the AI chip giant.

items.title: How Jensen's exit will help the US in the AI race vs. China: Roubini
items.summary: NYU Stern professor of economics and Hudson Bay Capital senior economic strategist Nouriel Roubini joins Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and Julie Hyman at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia (NVDA) and how it "paradoxically" widens the US lead over China in the AI race.

items.title: Nvidia executive Ian Buck emerges as CEO frontrunner on prediction markets
items.summary: Prediction markets are pointing to Nvidia VP Ian Buck as a frontrunner for permanent CEO role.

items.title: What's next for Nvidia after Jensen Huang's exit?
items.summary: Kelly Intelligence founder, CEO, and CCO Kevin Kelly joins Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre to dive into the tech trade using Alphspace at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference, discussing Nvidia's (NVDA) move lower following the ousting of former CEO Jensen Huang and the potential next moves for the GPU giant.

items.title: Nvidia CFO solid pick for interim CEO, but company outlook is clouded, Wall Street says
items.summary: Analysts on Wall Street have strong praise for Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress, but say the company's long-term outlook is still up in the air.
